intuition: A researcher has h-index h when at least h papers have citation counts of at least h.

brute_force.approach: Try every h from zero through the paper count and count qualifying papers each time.

optimal.approach: Sort citations descending and find the largest rank whose citation count reaches that rank.

edge_cases: Zero citations gives an h-index of zero.
The h-index cannot exceed the number of papers.
Citation counts beyond n do not change the maximum possible h.
